name: Nahum
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Nineveh under Nahum
cases.charge: A bloody city, full of lies and robbery, whose prey departeth not; the dwelling of the lions that filled his holes with prey; the wicked counsellor that imagineth evil against the Lord
cases.preview: Nahum’s burden of Nineveh declares the Lord jealous and avenging, slow to anger but never clearing the guilty, and names the wicked counsellor who came out of Nineveh imagining evil against Him…
